title: RefactorLog
description: Log of a single refactor operation applied to a document, referencing the originating cognition report.

manifest_version.description: Semantic version of the refactor log manifest format (e.g. "1.0.0").

analyzer_version.description: Semantic version of the Mnemosyne analyzer that produced the source cognition report.

analysis_mode.description: Execution mode that was used during the originating analysis pass.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file at the time of analysis, must match the cognition report source_hash.

source_file.description: Absolute or relative path to the source file that was refactored.

analysis_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which the originating analysis completed (from the cognition report).

refactored_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time at which this refactor operation completed.

transformations_applied.description: Ordered list of transformations applied to the document during this refactor operation.

sections_skipped.description: Sections that were excluded from refactoring, with reasons.

unresolved_warnings.description: Warnings from the originating cognition report that remain unresolved after refactoring.

Transformation.description: A single transformation applied to a section of the document.

section_id.description: Identifier of the section this transformation targets, matching a section id in the cognition report.

description.description: Human-readable description of what was changed and why.

safety_class.description: Risk classification for this transformation: 'safe' preserves semantics, 'moderate' may alter emphasis, 'high-risk' may alter meaning.

SkippedSection.description: A section that was intentionally excluded from refactoring.

section_id.description: Identifier of the skipped section, matching a section id in the cognition report.

reason.description: Explanation of why this section was not refactored.

Warning.description: A non-fatal warning carried over from the originating cognition report.

module.description: Name of the analyzer module that emitted this warning.
